tokens.name: blue-600
tokens.usage: Primary brand blue. Top of every screen gradient, links, active icons, primary accents. White text on it passes 4.5:1.

tokens.name: blue-500
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the screen gradient and header fade. White text on it only at 24px+ (3.4:1).

tokens.name: blue-300
tokens.usage: Lower gradient stop. Text over this area switches to navy-900.

tokens.name: blue-200
tokens.usage: Bottom gradient stop and photo placeholders. Text on it: navy-900 or ink.

tokens.name: blue-100
tokens.usage: Tint fill for highlighted chips (Worth it, Friends), avatar grounds, list icons.

tokens.name: blue-50
tokens.usage: Soft field fill: the 'One thing to know' input, unread notification rows, ask cards.

tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the light lower part of the gradient and on blue-100 chips.

tokens.name: on-blue-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on blue-600 headers (subtitles, counts). Never on white.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, bottom nav bar, selected chips, headings on white.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Body and review text on white or surface-2.

tokens.name: slate-700
tokens.usage: Secondary text, section labels (uppercase), inactive segmented labels.

tokens.name: slate-600
tokens.usage: Meta text: dates, counts, 'with Rahul'. Smallest text colour allowed on white (5.9:1).

tokens.name: slate-400
tokens.usage: Dashed chip outlines, placeholders, chevrons. Not for text that must be read.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders, dividers, the sheet handle.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The white sheet that rises over the blue header; inputs; the default page ground.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Cards and list rows on the white sheet (place cards, review card, settings groups).

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Segmented-control tracks and search fields on white.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Signature accent: the progress ring around glass circles, unread dots on blue, the 'All' dot. Decorative only, never text on white.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Verified visit, 'Available', high taste match, Saved state text.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Ground behind success text and badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Delete account, errors, required-field star. Text on white passes.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Ground behind error and delete-confirm panels.

tokens.name: cat-food
tokens.usage: Category: Food. Map pins and category dots.

tokens.name: cat-cafe
tokens.usage: Category: Café. Darkest pin, tells apart from Food by lightness.

tokens.name: cat-stay
tokens.usage: Category: Stay (hotels, hostels, homestays).

tokens.name: cat-trek
tokens.usage: Category: Trek.

tokens.name: cat-view
tokens.usage: Category: Viewpoint.

tokens.name: cat-temple
tokens.usage: Category: Temple.

tokens.name: cat-beach
tokens.usage: Category: Beach.

tokens.name: cat-other
tokens.usage: Category: Shop and Other.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Welcome and landing headlines. Pair one line of serif-accent in the middle.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Screen titles in the blue header.

styles.name: title-md
styles.usage: Section titles on the white sheet.

styles.name: serif-accent
styles.usage: The one italic word or phrase inside a sans headline. Scale to about 1.12x the sans size next to it.

styles.name: serif-place
styles.usage: Place names on cards, list names, friend names on profiles.

styles.name: serif-review
styles.sample: A palace right in the middle of the lake.
styles.usage: Review text and quotes from friends.

styles.name: serif-chip
styles.usage: Text inside dashed pills and method choices.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates, counts, small chip text. Colour slate-600 or darker.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The number inside a glass circle (rating, contact count).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in tight chips, segmented track padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside cards and rows (avatar to text).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; sheet side padding; nav bar inset from screen edges.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on blue headers and full-gradient screens.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space between major groups on onboarding screens.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top padding of every header, clear of the status bar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inner tiles: photo thumbs, icon squares, small inset boxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and list rows on the sheet.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Top corners of the white sheet over the blue header; large panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, inputs, the bottom nav bar. Clarity's default shape.

tokens.name: radius-device
tokens.usage: Phone frame corners in mockups and marketing.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Floating cards over the map, the selected-place card.

tokens.name: shadow-field
tokens.usage: White inputs sitting on the blue gradient.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Under glass circles on blue.

gradient.note: Gradients are part of the brand. Use them only as screen and header grounds, never on buttons or chips.

tokens.name: gradient-screen
tokens.usage: Full-screen ground for onboarding, Add a place, Offline. White text in the top half, navy-900 in the bottom third.

tokens.name: gradient-header
tokens.usage: Ground behind tab screens; the white sheet covers it from about 140 to 300px down.

tokens.name: gradient-glass
tokens.usage: Fill of glass circles. Add a 1px border of rgba(255,255,255,0.65).

size.note: Fixed heights that keep the touch targets consistent.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tappable size: icon buttons, chips with actions, toggles.

tokens.name: button-h
tokens.usage: Primary pill button height.

tokens.name: field-h
tokens.usage: Text input height.

tokens.name: chip-h
tokens.usage: Filter and tag chips. Onboarding hero chips use 52px.

tokens.name: nav-h
tokens.usage: Bottom nav bar height, floating 26px above the screen bottom.

tokens.name: screen-w
tokens.usage: Design width for app screens (iPhone 14/15).
